notes.title: Major Update - Easy Mode + New Title Screen + Misc Updates
notes.notes:
Easy Mode - Given the game's difficulty, and my kids desire to play Ninja Turdle, I decided to officially build "Easy Mode".

New Title Screen - I gave the title screen / game save selection screen a refresh.



Additional Updates:
- Nintendo Switch Pro Controller support + fixes (Mac M1)
- Minor map + sprite updates
- New Achievement for completion of game in Easy Mode
- New sound tracks




"Is this easy mode?" - D.Va
